facts.what: 承认自己从无天赋，Nova 只是更易活的伪装
facts.anchor: I don’t have a special gift, never have.

facts.what: 自悔自助书只翻不读、求助羞于开口
facts.anchor: Help was always something I’ve been too ashamed to ask for

facts.what: 冷笑说不会伤害 Blair，只要她记住自己是谁的女友
facts.anchor: ‘She’s my girlfriend. I wouldn’t hurt her. She just needs to remember that.’

facts.what: 反手抽 Blair 一巴掌
facts.anchor: the back of his hand skelps her across the face

facts.what: 意识到他从未爱过她，面具炸碎、自己的面纱也被掀开
facts.anchor: He never loved me. He never loved me. He never loved me.

facts.what: 揪 Blair 头发拖进厨房、抽出最锋利的刀抵喉
facts.anchor: placing the side of the knife flat against her throat

facts.what: 想到 Blair 曾逃走仍回来救她，决定必须行动
facts.anchor: she came back to help me. Someone she doesn’t even know

facts.what: 喊出三句肯定语后扑向两人
facts.anchor: ‘I am capable. I am brave. I am a good person.’

relations: Cassie 与 Blair 同处险境；George 持刀
